property_summary: After any call to newGrantProposal, the proposalCount must increase by exactly 1; the bug leaves it unchanged.

The reference contract increments proposalCount for each new proposal, so calling newGrantProposal increases proposalCount by 1; the bug decrements it, so calling newGrantProposal causes a net decrease from the initial value.
After any number of calls to newGrantProposal, the proposalCount must equal the number of successful calls, but the mutant fails to increment proposalCount, so it stays at its initial value.
After init, VADER equals the first argument _vader passed to init, never address(0).
